categories.main_business_segments: OurPalm Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the development, publishing, and operation of online games, with a focus on mobile games. The company operates globally, offering a diversified portfolio including MMORPGs, strategy games (SLG), card games, and mini-program games. It also invests in game-related equity and financial assets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced game development platforms such as Unreal Engine, employing technologies like PBR physical real-time rendering and GPU particle effects to enhance game quality. It integrates AI technologies for game modeling, code generation, and content innovation, improving development efficiency and gameplay experience. The company emphasizes research and development with a strong in-house team and continuous iteration of game products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: OurPalm serves a broad customer base including individual gamers across China, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America. Its games target mainstream markets with a focus on mobile gamers and users of mini-program games. The company’s key customers include major game distribution platforms and end-users who engage in in-game purchases.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in domestic Chinese markets and overseas markets including Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America. It has subsidiaries and offices in China’s major cities and international locations such as Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, and Singapore, supporting localized game development and publishing.
categories.supply_chain_position: OurPalm operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the gaming supply chain, focusing on game development, publishing, and operation. It also holds upstream equity investments in related technology and content providers but does not engage in hardware manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on sustainable development through integrated research and operation, emphasizing high-quality game production and global market expansion. It prioritizes the development of SLG and mini-program games, leveraging AI technologies for innovation. R&D efforts concentrate on licensed IP games, new game genres, and enhancing user engagement and retention.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is mainly generated through direct sales of virtual game items via in-game purchases (freemium model) across self-operated and third-party platforms. The company also earns revenue from licensing, joint operations, and equity investment returns. Its income is derived from domestic and overseas game sales, with a significant portion from mobile game virtual goods.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: OurPalm is positioned as a leading global Chinese game developer and publisher with strong IP resources and international distribution capabilities. It competes with other major Chinese and international game companies in the mobile and online gaming sectors. Its competitive advantages include diversified product offerings, strong R&D, and international market penetration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 818.7 million, a 16.61% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 110.9 million, down 40.68%. Despite revenue decline due to product lifecycle and delayed SLG game launches, the company maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 5.3 billion and continues investing heavily in R&D (over 32% of revenue). Cash flow from operations improved significantly by nearly 70%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: OurPalm emphasizes delivering high-quality, immersive gaming experiences through advanced technology and premium IP licenses. Its globalized development and publishing system ensures localized content and services, enhancing user satisfaction. The company’s diversified game portfolio and continuous innovation, including AI integration, differentiate it in a competitive market, aiming to extend product lifecycles and deepen user engagement.
